name: Ontraport
description_en:
Ontraport combines CRM records and automation maps for follow-up, internal tasks and related business processes. Maps use triggers, goals, actions and filters to react to record changes or customer activity. Documented actions include email/SMS, assigning a task, updating membership access and sending contacts to another map.

Its model is not just a linear email series: a contact can occupy multiple places on one map, a goal can move or add them, and a standard End keeps them on the map. Evaluating those distinctions is essential before using the same design for lead delivery, nurture and post-purchase work. This profile is original documentation research; no contact, purchase, map or message was operated.
description_zh:
Ontraport 将 CRM 记录与自动化地图组合，用于跟进、内部任务及相关业务流程。地图通过入口、目标、动作及筛选响应记录变化或客户行为。文档动作包括邮件／短信、任务分配、会员权限更新及将联系人送至另一地图。

其模型不只是线性邮件序列：联系人可同时占据地图多个位置，目标可以移动或再次添加联系人，普通 End 会将其留在地图。将同一设计用于资料交付、培育及购买后流程前，需要评估这些区别。本文为原创文档研究，未操作联系人、购买、地图或消息。

core_features.explanation_en: CRM changes and external interactions can activate triggers and goals.
core_features.explanation_zh: CRM 变化及外部互动可触发入口和目标。

core_features.explanation_en: A goal can move an existing contact away from intermediate steps or add another instance.
core_features.explanation_zh: 目标可将已有联系人移离中间步骤，或添加另一个实例。

core_features.explanation_en: Add to Automation and forks coordinate sub-processes with the original map.
core_features.explanation_zh: Add to Automation 及分叉协调子流程与原地图。

core_features.explanation_en: Performance Mode can highlight the path and current location for a selected record ID.
core_features.explanation_zh: Performance Mode 可按指定记录 ID 标注路径及当前位置。

en: Editorial fit: CRM-led businesses joining lead capture, nurture, staff tasks and customer fulfillment in one data model.
Editorial fit: teams willing to model concurrent contact paths and test goals, waits and nested maps carefully.
zh: 编辑判断的适用场景：在统一数据模型中连接线索收集、培育、员工任务及客户交付的 CRM 驱动企业。
编辑判断的适用场景：愿意建模联系人并发路径，仔细测试目标、等待及嵌套地图的团队。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Define the record/event and explicit ignore/move/add-again behavior.
steps.zh: 定义记录／事件及明确的忽略／移动／再次添加行为。

steps.en: Choose goal scope, non-achievement path, wait behavior and End versus Exit.
steps.zh: 选择目标范围、未达成路径、等待行为及 End／Exit。

steps.en: Use an internal-only copy to inspect actions, parallel positions and nested return timing.
steps.zh: 用仅限内部的副本检查动作、并发位置及嵌套返回时间。

steps.en: Reconcile a record trace with cohort-based performance and obtain the current commercial offer.
steps.zh: 核对记录路径与群体报告，并取得当前商业方案。

items.en: One record can have multiple map instances; aggregate element counts are not automatically unique people.
items.zh: 一条记录可有多个地图实例；元素汇总并不自动等于独立人数。

items.en: Past-date waits can strand contacts; deleting occupied elements removes them and shortening waits can release them immediately.
items.zh: 已过日期等待可能卡住联系人；删除被占用节点会移出联系人，缩短等待可能立即放行。

items.en: No measured delivery SLA, webhook retry policy, pause-clock preservation or message-recall guarantee established.
items.zh: 未确认实测投递 SLA、webhook 重试政策、暂停时钟保留或消息撤回保证。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Current official page confirms a 14-day no-card trial, monthly or annual subscriptions, and annual commitment with two months advertised free. Numerical plan prices, contact/user allowances, message quotas and add-ons were not visible in the public-reader body or ordinary TLS-verified HTTPS text; no normalized price assigned. Obtain the applicable plan and setup/messaging costs from the actual offer. No sustained free plan verified.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 当前官方页确认无需信用卡的 14 天试用、月／年订阅及承诺一年的年付赠送两个月。公开读取正文及普通 TLS 校验 HTTPS 文本未显示数字套餐价、联系人／用户额度、消息额度及附加项，不生成标准化价格。应从真实方案取得适用套餐及设置／消息费用。未核实持续免费套餐。

sections.title_en: Repeated events can ignore, move or duplicate a contact
sections.title_zh: 重复事件可忽略、移动或复制联系人位置
sections.en: Trigger scope distinguishes any contact in the account from contacts already on the map; the latter cannot admit someone new. For an existing contact, Ignore leaves the current position, Move here changes position, and Add here again creates another instance. A separate once-per-contact checkbox restricts repeat activation. For an editorial lead-magnet design, determine whether a second request should restart nurture, deliver another asset concurrently or do nothing. Do not assume one contact record means one active path.
sections.zh: 入口范围区分账户全部联系人与仅地图已有联系人，后者不能加入新人员。对已有联系人，Ignore 保留位置，Move here 改变位置，Add here again 新增实例。另有每联系人仅一次选项限制重复。编辑示例：资料领取设计应明确第二次请求需要重启培育、并发交付另一资料，还是不执行。不能假设一条联系人记录只对应一条活动路径。

sections.title_en: A goal changes routing, not just the report
sections.title_zh: 目标改变路由，不只是报表指标
sections.en: Goal settings choose eligible scope: previous waits, direct upstream elements, any contact on the map or any contact in the account. Move here removes other positions on the map, whereas Add here again retains them. Once-per-contact activation is independently selectable. For a purchase goal, confirm the chosen scope and movement behavior before expecting it to stop sales reminders. The direct-upstream option follows the arrows above the goal; a visually nearby but unconnected branch is not upstream.
sections.zh: 目标设置选择资格范围：前置等待、直接上游元素、地图全部联系人或账户全部联系人。Move here 移除地图其他位置，Add here again 则保留。每联系人仅一次可独立选择。购买目标应先确认范围及移动方式，才能期待其停止推销提醒。直接上游需沿目标上方箭头连接；视觉相邻但不连接的分支不是上游。

sections.title_en: Waiting and ending do not necessarily remove a contact
sections.title_zh: 等待和结束不一定移出联系人
sections.en: A one-day wait means a full 24 hours; adding a time-of-day constraint can extend it further. Arriving after a fixed target date leaves the contact stuck until moved. A standard End also keeps the contact on the map, available to later triggers/goals; toggling Remove from this automation makes it an Exit instead. For a time-sensitive event sequence, test a late entrant and intentionally choose the end state. Publishing more steps above an End does not automatically move contacts sitting there.
sections.zh: 一天等待是完整 24 小时，再加时刻约束可能更长。超过固定目标日期才到达的联系人会卡住，直至被移动。普通 End 同样保留联系人，可被后续入口／目标移动；切换 Remove from this automation 才成为 Exit。限时活动序列应测试迟到者，并明确选择结束状态。在 End 上方发布更多步骤不会自动移动已在其上的联系人。

sections.title_en: A nested map may temporarily hold the original process
sections.title_zh: 嵌套地图可能暂时占住原流程
sections.en: Add to Automation sends a contact through the target map’s default added trigger. The actions guide describes return after an End/Exit or a qualifying original-map goal, with a cron delay of up to 15 minutes. A fork is needed when the original path should continue simultaneously. Separately, Pause/Unpause holds a contact on a selected map until unpaused through another map. Legacy sequence actions have different return conditions and are explicitly marked legacy. Evaluate the current map model rather than transferring legacy sequence behavior to it.
sections.zh: Add to Automation 通过目标地图默认加入入口发送联系人。动作指南描述到达 End／Exit 或满足原地图目标后返回，cron 延迟最多 15 分钟。原路径需要同时继续时，应使用分叉。另行的 Pause／Unpause 将联系人留在所选地图，直至通过另一地图恢复。旧 sequence 动作有不同返回条件，且明确标为旧功能。应评估当前地图模型，不能套用旧序列行为。

sections.title_en: Changing an occupied element has immediate consequences
sections.title_zh: 修改被占用元素会产生实际后果
sections.en: Deleting an element with contacts sitting on it removes those contacts from the map; deleting a whole branch can therefore affect more than the drawing. Shortening an existing wait credits time already waited, so contacts past the new duration proceed immediately. Before editing an active map, inspect occupied waits/ends and identify which contacts would move or be removed. These documented effects make an isolated copy useful for evaluation; no live-version migration, queued-message recall or general rollback guarantee was established.
sections.zh: 删除被联系人占用的元素会将其移出地图，因此删除整条分支可能不只是修改图形。缩短已有等待会计入已等待时间，超过新时长的联系人立即继续。编辑活动地图前，应检查被占用等待／结束节点，并识别谁会移动或移出。这些文档效果使独立副本适合评估；未确认活动版本迁移、队列消息撤回或通用回滚保证。

sections.title_en: An accelerated copy still executes real actions
sections.title_zh: 加速副本仍执行真实动作
sections.en: The University transcript proposes copying the map, shortening waits and using a test contact to exercise triggers and goals. It then checks messages, assigned tasks, webhooks, order and unintended parallel positions. This is a real internal-contact exercise, not a claim of a sandbox simulator; copied actions can still have effects. As editorial guidance, restrict the copy to internal identities and inspect every external destination before publishing it. The transcript notes some page visits can take up to 15 minutes to reach the contact record, so immediate visual silence is not conclusive failure evidence.
sections.zh: 大学教程文本建议复制地图、缩短等待，使用测试联系人验证入口及目标，再检查消息、分配任务、webhook、执行顺序及非预期并发位置。这是实际内部联系人测试，不能称为沙箱模拟；复制的动作仍可能产生影响。编辑建议：发布副本前限制内部身份，并检查所有外部目标。教程说部分页面访问最多需 15 分钟进入联系人记录，不能仅因界面未立即变化判断失败。

sections.title_en: Cohort and uniqueness explain apparently inconsistent totals
sections.title_zh: 群体及去重规则解释看似不一致总数
sections.en: Performance Mode’s date filter selects contacts added in that range, not simply every action occurring then. Its were-here count is unique and records the first addition, while contacts can concurrently occupy several locations. For an individual check, the stats guide documents tracing a record using its system ID and highlighting past/current elements. Compare one contact’s path with the chosen cohort before adding element counts as if they were independent people. ROI and UTM reporting availability depends on plan; message opens and goal conversion are not independently measured business lift.
sections.zh: Performance Mode 日期筛选选择期间内加入的联系人，并非当时发生的全部动作。were-here 按独立联系人计数，记录首次加入，而联系人可同时占多个位置。个人检查方面，统计指南记录了用系统 ID 追踪并突出过去／当前元素的方法。将元素人数当作互不重叠用户加总前，应比较个人路径与所选群体。ROI 和 UTM 报告受套餐约束；消息打开及目标转化不是独立测量的业务提升。

sections.title_en: Confirm numerical fees and feature allowances in the actual offer
sections.title_zh: 在真实方案中确认金额与功能额度
sections.en: The current pricing body verifies a 14-day trial without a credit card, monthly or annual billing, and an annual commitment with two months advertised free. It does not expose numerical plan amounts in the read page or ordinary HTTPS body extraction. Support guides name account tiers, but those labels do not establish current contact quotas, sending allowances or fees. Before comparing total cost, obtain the applicable automation/reporting tier, user and contact allowances, messaging charges and any setup package. Trial access is not sustained free software.
sections.zh: 当前价格正文确认无需信用卡的 14 天试用、月付或年付，以及年付承诺一年并宣传赠送两个月。实读页面及普通 HTTPS 正文提取未显示数字套餐金额。支持指南提到账号档位，但名称不能确认当前联系人数、发送额度或费用。比较总成本前，应取得适用自动化／报告档位、用户及联系人额度、消息费用及可能的设置服务包。试用不等于持续免费软件。
